answer: Randomised submission windows act as a temporal trellis: each identity must stake 500 POA and be online in an unpredictable 40-second slot. Cloning 1,000 wallets costs 500,000 POA plus 250 CPU-hours of monitoring. The velvet of steady honest uptime lets the signal separate real operators from farms, since missed windows slash rewards to zero. Clones bleed stake faster than they earn; the mechanism works because attack cost scales with clone count while honest cost stays flat.
